item.title: GameChange Energy Acquires Terrasmart’s eBOS Unit To Expand Utility-Scale Solar Offering
item.description: GameChange Energy Technologies said it has acquired the electrical balance of systems (eBOS) division of Terrasmart, a subsidiary of Gibraltar Industries, in a move aimed at strengthening its ability to deliver integrated infrastructure for utility-scale solar projects. The company said the acquisition adds pre-engineered and prefabricated electrical solutions that manage connections between solar modules, inverters and downstream grid equipment, expanding its module-to-grid platform. item.title: Energy Sector Trails Peers In AI Prioritisation, But Adoption Set To Accelerate: KPMG
item.description: The energy sector is lagging other industries in prioritising artificial intelligence investments, though adoption is expected to accelerate as companies move beyond pilot projects, according to a report by KPMG. In its report “AI’s Dual Promise”, KPMG said 69% of energy executives identified AI as a technology investment priority, below the cross-industry average of 77%. item.title: GREW Solar Secures 500 MW Module Supply Order from Leading Indian Power Developer
item.description: GREW Solar, one of India’s solar PV module manufacturers, has secured an order to supply 500 MW of high-efficiency solar PV modules from a leading power developer in India. The modules will be deployed across multiple upcoming utility-scale solar projects in different locations nationwide. The order involves the company’s advanced M10R and G12R module series, which are designed to deliver strong performance, reliability, and efficiency under varied operating conditions. item.description: Xcel Energy is set to power a new Google data center in Pine Island, Minnesota, a project expected to deliver a significant boost to the state’s economy. item.title: ENGIE Commissions Assú Sol, Its Largest Operational Solar Project Globally
item.description: ENGIE has fully commissioned the Assú Sol photovoltaic complex in Brazil, marking the company’s largest solar project currently in operation worldwide. item.title: INOX Air Products Ties Up with TACC to Supply Nitrogen for Lithium-Ion Anode Plant in MP
item.description: INOX Air Products Private Limited (INOXAP) entered into a long-term partnership with TACC Limited (The Advanced Carbons Company) (TACC) to supply Nitrogen through an onsite Nitrogen plant. item.title: Vikram Solar Gets 378.75 MW Order in its First INGEL Solar Project Partnership
item.description: Kolkata-based solar module manufacturer Vikram Solar has secured an order to supply 378.75 MW of solar modules for a major project tendered by NTPC Green Energy Limited (NGEL). The modules will be supplied for a project located in Gujarat’s Kutch district, with deliveries expected to commence in FY26.
